upstream.description: Master the art of designing and organizing AI agents. Learn to automate complex, multi-step business processes by creating specialized AI agent teams using the open-source library crewAI.

classification.analysis: This is the notebook set for DeepLearning.AI's 'Multi AI Agent Systems with crewAI' short course, taught by CrewAI founder João Moura, covering role-playing agents, memory, tools, and cooperation patterns (sequential, parallel, hierarchical) using the open-source crewAI library. Each lesson notebook builds a business-process crew — research/writing, customer support, outreach, event planning, financial analysis, resume tailoring — as a worked example rather than a reusable library. It's course material for developers learning multi-agent design, unmaintained since 2024 (course content is static by nature).

use_cases.title: Learn crewAI's role/goal/backstory pattern via worked notebooks
Copy a multi-agent business-process example (support, outreach, event planning)
See sequential vs hierarchical agent crew orchestration examples
